Subject: Reconnecting after AIOps Showcase — pilot & demo timing

Hi Ayesha / Connor —

Great to meet you both at the AIOps Showcase last week — thanks for stopping by the Redwood booth. Quick recap from our chat:

- EdgeOps is focused on low-latency inference at the edge for anomaly detection and log summarization.
- You mentioned a Q4 pilot (10–12 nodes, mixed batch/low-latency) and interest in private deployment options (VPC/on-prem).
- Main selection criteria: predictable tail latency, cost per inference, and SOC 2/PII handling.

Next steps I suggested on the floor: schedule a 45-minute technical demo + integration checklist, and share a short pilot plan and SOW template for procurement. I attached the post-conference deck with a suggested pilot flow.

Proposed demo slots:
- Wed 2026-09-29 11:00 AM PT
- Thu 2026-09-30 9:00 AM PT

If either of those works, I’ll send a calendar invite and loop in Marissa from Customer Success to run the integration checklist. If timing shifted or priority has changed since the show, please let me know — happy to adjust.

Attachments: redwood-postconf-deck.pdf (high-level pilot plan)

Thanks,
Ben Carter
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0142

Thanks for the follow-up and the deck — good summary. We are internally prioritizing a Q4 pilot but still aligning stakeholders (infra, security, procurement). A couple quick asks before we lock a slot:

2) Do you have a one-page SOC 2 summary or link we can share with security?

I’ll try to confirm internal availability this week and get back on the two demo slots you proposed.
